articles.title: A Fireball From Above: ISS Astronaut Captures Rare Reentry Spectacle
articles.summary: From the ISS Cupola, astronaut Chris Williams spotted a fireball streaking below him over West Africa. The dramatic breakup was likely the upper stage of a Soyuz rocket reentering the atmosphere.

articles.title: From Hot Pink to Green: Katydid's Color Shift Baffles Scientists
articles.summary: A katydid in Panama transformed from vivid pink to green in 11 days, likely mimicking rainforest leaves that change color as they mature. This is the first documented full color transition in an adult katydid.

articles.title: Teaching Robots to Feel: DAIMON's Massive Touch Dataset Aims to Transform Dexterous Manipulation
articles.summary: DAIMON Robotics released Daimon-Infinity, the largest omni-modal dataset for physical AI, featuring high-res tactile data from 80+ real-world tasks. The open-source release aims to overcome data scarcity in robot learning.
